 By danierayn , Jon Ryan , Shailyn Cotten , +131 more Updated : Nov 3, 2026 12:45pm UTC Add IGN on Google The 44.1 Patch for PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds has arrived, bringing with it an IVE collab, and various balance updates, adjustments, and general bug fixes.
 This page acts as a comprehensive breakdown of the 44.1 Patch for PUBG, including a link to the full Patch Notes. 
 HLB: DAWNBREAKERS OF RONDO 
 SLB: Dawnbreakers of Rondo returns with a new Nightmare difficulty as well as more powerful Hungers.
 Instead of the previous Rookie and Veteran difficulties, a single “Nightmare" difficulty is available.
 Of the six previously available stages, only Jadena City is featured.
 Stage and difficulty voting will not be held.
 More powerful and diverse special Hungers appear.
 Hungers' attack power and HP are increased.
 Hungers spawn more frequently, with a wider variety appearing from earlier phases.
 The number of fuel canisters required to activate generators increases.
 The final capacitor defense is more challenging due to stronger Hunger attacks.
 A special environmental presentation of Rondo engulfed in flames is applied for the Nightmare difficulty.
 The mode is balanced for a four-player squad, with no difficulty scaling based on team size.
 You can join a match as a solo player.
 You can check the leaderboard sorted by fastest clear times for the Nightmare difficulty in PUBG Bridge.
 Xeno Point: Hell 
 Stronger enemies and severe survival tests await, with higher difficulty and new rules to contend with. Contender skins and progressive weapon skins cannot be used. If you have a Contender skin equipped, you will be switched to the default character.
 Difficulty
 Instead of the previous Normal, Hard, and Impossible difficulties, a single “Hell" difficulty is available.
 Enemy difficulty varies by sector.
 Sector 1: Previous Normal difficulty level
 Sector 2: Previous Hard difficulty level
 Sector 3 and Mothership: Previous Impossible difficulty level
 Balance Adjustments by Player Count
 Enemy HP, attack power, and the amount of obtainable currency are automatically adjusted based on the number of squad members.
 Different balance settings are applied based on the number of players (1–4).
 If team members join or leave during a stage, the balance is adjusted based on the current number of players.
 A notification is displayed when balance changes.
 Combat Balance
 The invincibility during reloading with a vest equipped is changed to an effect that temporarily reduces damage received for a certain duration.
 The existing invincibility effect that applies when using Super Skills and healing is maintained.
 Death Penalty
 Upon death, one of the weapons and gear currently equipped is randomly removed.
 All items held in the inventory are removed as before.
 The same penalty is applied if you leave a match during a stage.
 Skill Changes
 The effects of skills that previously granted weapons and gear are changed as follows:
 Starter Boost: Start with an Adrenaline Syringe when the next session begins after death
 Prime Striker: Start without losing weapons when the next session begins after death
 Prime Conduit: Start without losing gear when the next session begins after death
 You can check the leaderboard sorted by the fastest clear times in the Mothership sector in PUBG Bridge.
 Gunplay 
 End of LMG Meta Rotation
 Reload time, recoil, aiming speed, vehicle target damage multiplier, recoil control effect by firing stance, and world spawn amounts for LMGs are adjusted back to the level before the August update.
 RPD, newly added in the August update, is balanced to a similar level to other LMG weapons.
 Gameplay 
 Vehicle Balance
 Vehicle health increases by 8-15% depending on the type of vehicle:
 Motorcycle, Scooter, Dirt Bike, Snowmobile, Motor Glider, Aquarail, Boat, Buggy, Quad: 8% increase
 Pillar Security Car, Dacia, Mirado, Coupe RB, Pony Coupe, Tukshai, Zima, UAZ, Pickup, Rony, Blanc: 10% increase
 Porter, Pico Bus, Van, Food Truck, Pillar UAZ, BRDM-2: 15% increase
 Tire durability is increased for some vehicles:
 Buggy, Pillar UAZ, Quad: 7.5% increase
 Zima, UAZ, Blanc, Rony, Pickup: 30% increase
 Porter, Food Truck, Van, Pico Bus: 75% increase
 BRDM-2
 The acceleration and hill-climbing performance are improved to allow smoother driving on hilly terrain.
 Maximum speed increases.
 Buggy
 Tire friction is increased to mitigate excessive sliding on certain terrain.
 Trunk
 A trunk function is added to Van, Pico Bus, and Food Truck.
 Trunk capacity: 300
 Trunk capacity of Coupe RB is increased.
 100 → 120
 Item Spawn Improvements 
 The spacing between items spawned in the same area has been adjusted to reduce the phenomenon of items overlapping or being hidden behind one another.
 Kick Action Improvements 
 Even if you get hit by another player’s kick while using emotes during the waiting period before a match, your emote will not be canceled.
 The push-back effect caused by a kick will be applied as before.
 Fixed an issue where players standing on sloped terrain were pushed excessively far when kicked.
 Observer Mode Improvements 
 (PC) Blue Chip Count Display
 The number of Blue Chips held by the spectated player is displayed in the inventory area at the bottom of the spectating screen.
 The total count is displayed without distinguishing between friendly and enemy Blue Chips.
 (PC) Player Inventory Check
 Press the I key while spectating a player to view their inventory.
 Other Improvements
 You can view a player’s inventory even while spectating an enemy player.
 The corresponding player’s name is displayed on Blue Chips stored in vehicle trunks.
 (PC) Special Vehicle Skin Usability Improvements 
 When near a vehicle compatible with a Special Vehicle Skin, pressing and holding the H key opens the Vehicle Skin Radial, which takes priority over Co-op Climb.
 In this situation, Co-op Climb cannot be used.
 World 
 The PGC 2026 theme and banner are applied to the Starting Plane on all maps.
 Not applied to the Supply Plane and Helicopters.
 PGC 2026 promotional images are applied to billboards placed on maps.
 Rondo
 Rondo's terrain destruction textures have been improved to make destroyed areas easier to identify.
 The textures exposed after terrain destruction will appear darker than before.
 This makes it easier to distinguish destroyed areas from intact ones.
 Ranked 
 Season 44
 Ranked Weapon Skin - P90 can be obtained as a permanent Tier Reward.
 The leaderboard will reset with the live server maintenance.
 Check out your final Tier from the previous season through your Career page.
 Minimum achievement standards required by tier have been raised in the Platinum tier and above.
 Matchmaking 
 Service Termination
 Console
 NA: Solo (FPP), Duo (FPP)
 APAC: Duo
 Daily Operating Hours (UTC)
 Some regions and modes will have daily operating hours applied.
 Console
 SA Duo: 17:00 - next day 05:00
 EU Duo: 08:00 - next day 00:00
 NA Solo: 13:00 - next day 08:00
 APAC Solo: 02:00 - 16:00
 PC
 SA Duo (FPP): 12:00 - next day 07:00
 NA Duo (FPP): 14:00 - next day 09:00
 KAKAO Duo: 00:00 - 21:00
 (Console) Controller Input Improvements 
 The response time for distinguishing between tapping and holding a button has been reduced.
 Actions directly related to gameplay: 0.3 seconds → 0.2 seconds
 Examples: Character actions such as going prone and throwing items, as well as World Map and Inventory controls.
 Other actions: 1.0 second → 0.5 seconds
 Examples: System menu controls, such as opening the Settings menu.
 Message Radial Improvements
 The Message Radial now remains open even after releasing the R Stick once it has been activated by holding the stick.
 Move the R Stick to navigate through the available options.
 Release the R Stick after moving it toward the desired option to select the corresponding message.
 These changes apply to the in-game, World Map, and Inventory Message Radials.
 Press B or RB to close the Message Radial without selecting a message.
 Other Controller Input Improvements
 Fixed an issue where the actions for moving items to the trunk and switching weapon slots were assigned to the same button in the Inventory.
 Move Items to Trunk : Hold L-Stick
 Weapon Slot Change : Double-tap LT
 UX/UI 
 (PC) Some confirmation shortcuts are changed from Space Bar to Enter.
 (Console) The range of movement of the virtual cursor is improved.
 Performance 
 Voice chat quality and stability are improved.
 Supply Bay 
 A function that allows you to move directly between Step Up and Supply Bay is added.
 A function that allows you to preview the detailed composition of Milestone Rewards is added.
 You can view reward details for single items as well as selectable items and sets containing multiple components.
 Workshop 
 New items have been added to Hunter’s Chests.
 Survivor Pass: Off Range
 True Elegance
 More Items for Special Disassembly
 Contenders and Contender-related items that are always available for purchase are now eligible for Special Disassembly.
 You can obtain Artisan Tokens by using Special Disassembly on Contender items.
 Special Disassembly can be accessed from the Disassemble menu under Workshop > Regular Crafting > Craft.
 Workshop UX/UI Improvements
 While the Special Disassembly is available, a button to move from Special Crafting to Special Disassembly is always displayed.
 Some buttons and item selection UI on the Regular Crafting and Special Crafting screens are improved.
 Bug Fixes 
 Gameplay
 Fixed an issue where players took unintended damage or died when jumping onto Emergency Cover airdrop deployed on world transportation vehicles.
 Fixed an issue where the jump interaction was not displayed when the Blue Chip Recall Plane's flight path overlapped with an unplayable area.
 Fixed an issue where players could equip items from loot crates and care packages even after moving beyond the intended interaction range while dragging the items.
 (PC) Fixed an issue where certain devices and gameplay rules did not function as intended in the CARNIVAL RUSH creation in Playgrounds.
 (Console) Fixed an issue where players could not switch perspectives after using a Super Skill in Xenopoint when both actions were assigned to the same button.
 World
 Fixed an issue where multiple explosion effects would play simultaneously when an explosion that occurred outside the player's field of view came into view on Sanhok.
 UX/UI
 Fixed an issue where a different vehicle skin was displayed in the vehicle skin radial menu instead of the currently equipped skin.
 Fixed an issue where the Minimap grid and scale were displayed incorrectly when zooming in and out of the Minimap while boarding the plane from the Starting Island.
 Fixed an issue where the weapon slot icon was temporarily displayed with incorrect proportions when picking up a primary weapon for the first time.
 Fixed an issue where the character preview rotation did not work after equipping an emote via drag and drop in Customize.
 Fixed an issue where an unintended item list was displayed when switching categories under Customize > Character > Wardrobe.
 Fixed an issue where an unintended message was displayed on the map selection screen when switching between Normal Match and Ranked lobbies.
 Fixed an issue where the nickname was displayed in an incorrect position under certain conditions when the Stellar Blade - Wasteland Lobby Skin was equipped.
 Fixed an issue where an unintended pop-up sound was played when viewing Reputation Level information under Career > Overview.
 Fixed an issue where certain text was displayed incorrectly in the Vehicle Info radial message.
 Fixed an issue where Special Vehicle Skins were displayed in a different slot order than configured in the in-game vehicle skin radial menu.
 (PC) Fixed an issue where previous party members' characters remained visible in the lobby and voice chat remained active after being kicked from the party.
 (PC) Fixed an issue where certain text in kill events on the Replay Timeline was displayed incorrectly.
 Items and Skins
 Fixed a graphical issue with the stock of the Progressive Weapon Skin "Faded Ghost - AWM."
 Fixed an issue where parts of the Bearly Awake Backpack (Level 2) appeared transparent.
 Fixed a clipping issue when the female character wearing PLAYERUNKNOWN'S Trenchcoat with certain skirts.
 Fixed an issue where the character's weapon-holding pose was displayed incorrectly when selecting the Go button after obtaining a weapon skin.
 Fixed an issue where item images overlapped in the inventory when repeatedly swapping between the Vehicle Camo Netting and Pan with the Void - Pan skin equipped.
 Fixed an issue where the Extended Mag attached to a weapon carried on another player's back would occasionally appear to float in midair, detached from the weapon.
 (PC) Fixed an issue where the inner visual effect of the Void - Pan skin was not displayed in the inventory under certain conditions.
 Full Patch Notes 
 If you wish to read the Patch Notes in full, you can do so via the official PUBG websites 44.1 Patch Notes post.
